summary: Comprehensive testing of Options Master (Indian options paper-trading app). All 15 backend pytest cases passed (health, login, market snapshot, option chain, strategies, recommended, advisor with real Claude Sonnet 4.5 LLM response, apply trade, list trades w/ unrealized PnL, close trade w/ capital update, portfolio, daily reward dedup, pro upgrade). Frontend mobile UI verified: login screen, Home tab with greeting/capital/3 tickers/AI advisor button/gamification cards, AI advisor fetches a real LLM explanation (Bull Put Spread bullets observed), Apply Strategy creates a paper trade, tab navigation works (Strategies, Chain, Portfolio, Profile reachable via href), Profile tab Pro upgrade flips capital from ₹1,00,000 → ₹10,00,000 and shows PRO badge + 30 days remaining + Sign Out. End-to-end integration between Expo frontend and FastAPI backend is functional.

issues: Console warning: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' — already passed as prop in code but a duplicate may still be in styles; cosmetic only.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' from a third-party lib; non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Expo SDK reports version mismatches: @react-native-async-storage/async-storage@3.0.2 (expected 2.2.0), react-native-svg@15.15.5 (expected 15.12.1). App still runs; consider aligning to expo-recommended versions for native builds.

action_items: (Optional) Add testID to bottom tab items (e.g. testID='tab-strategies') for more reliable RN tab testing — currently anchors-by-href works on web but native Tab.Screen items don't yet expose testIDs.
(Optional) Align @react-native-async-storage/async-storage and react-native-svg versions to Expo-recommended ones to silence SDK warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses a single file (~620 lines) — acceptable for MVP, but consider splitting market/strategies/trades into modules if it grows past 700 lines.
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded via projection on all reads (verified).
All endpoints use proper HTTPException with codes (400/404).
Pydantic models validate inputs on all POST endpoints (LoginIn, ApplyStrategyIn, CloseTradeIn, AdvisorIn).
AI advisor has a safe fallback when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY call fails — confirmed Claude Sonnet 4.5 returned a real bulleted explanation during testing.
Username is normalised to lowercase server-side; frontend also lowercases before sending — consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (login, home, advisor, tickers, navigation, pro upgrade, profile)

seed_data_creation: Created test users via /api/auth/login during pytest (TEST_<uuid>, reward_<uuid>, pro_<uuid>) and one paper trade per run. Also exercised 'rohit' user for UI flow. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_options_master.py and uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. The AI advisor test calls Claude Sonnet 4.5 via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and accepts either real LLM or rule-based fallback. Tab nav in Expo Router renders <a href='/strategies'> etc on web — use href selectors for tab clicks rather than role=button (which doesn't match Expo's tab buttons). All tabs keep prior content mounted, so page.locator('body').inner_text() returns combined text from all tabs; rely on screenshots or scoped selectors to verify active tab.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. All requested flows behave per spec.
